voice.noSettings: The server's settings cannot be asked ({why}).
voice.saved: Saved: the next call uses it.

answer.orchestrator: The channel's assistant itself takes the call: it sees how things are, sends work itself, and remembers what you said. Agora reaches one endpoint on this computer through a public address (voice.line.url in the configuration, such as Tailscale Funnel; cloudflared opened for the call when unset); only that endpoint is exposed, with a key per call.
answer.moss: MOSS Live takes the call directly over a local WebSocket with your MOSS key — no Agora credentials or tunnel needed — and hands farm work to the assistant.
answer.agora: A model hosted by Agora, no other key needed.
answer.deepseek: Uses the DeepSeek key in the settings ({from}).
answer.noDeepseek: Uses the DeepSeek key in the settings, which is not there yet: fill it in under Settings.
answer.openai: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: Qwen, Kimi, your own deployment…

voice.intro: The assistant hears you and answers through Agora's conversational AI. Here you set up the line: the credentials, how it listens and who answers can all be hosted by Agora (no other key), or your own services. The assistant's persona, greeting and voice are on the
voice.nextCall: Changes take effect on the next call
voice.areaHint: The region of Agora's endpoints: pick one near the server; repos in mainland China pick Mainland China.
voice.microsoft: Microsoft Azure speech, with your own key.
voice.hosted: Hosted by Agora, no other key needed.
voice.languageHint: Which language to hear. The persona should say to answer in it too.
voice.azureAreaHint: The region of the speech resource, such as eastasia or eastus.
voice.llmAddress: The full address of an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.
voice.dictationIntro: Sent to the OpenAI-compatible address you fill in; with a local speech-server, the sound stays on this computer.
voice.dictationAddress: Up to /v1. Local: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1; OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1. Empty turns dictation off.
voice.dictationModel: qwen3 for a local speech-server; gpt-4o-mini-transcribe for OpenAI.

persona.intro: How the assistant opens a call and what voice it uses. The credentials, how it listens and who answers are on the
persona.ownCall: The assistant takes the call itself: it is the channel's assistant, with its own prompt and no separate persona.
persona.personaHint: Who the model that answers first on the call is, and how it speaks. It cannot see how things are; the assistant on this computer sends work. Tell it not to make up progress.
persona.greetingHint: The first thing said when the call connects.
persona.failureHint: What is said when the model fails.
persona.azureVoice: An Azure neural voice name, such as en-US-JennyNeural.
persona.minimaxVoice: Click a name to pick it, the play button on its left to hear it first; or fill in another MiniMax system voice id below.

voice.dictationMossIntro: The server transcribes recordings using the MOSS connection and dictation model selected in AI services.

moss.intro: Talk to MOSS Live directly and hear how it answers; the line goes through this machine's server, and the key never leaves it. Nothing goes to the chat.
moss.nativeNotice: Choose MOSS Live as the call answer provider and save the configuration first. Starting captures your microphone and sends audio to the configured MOSS account; charges may apply. Final transcripts are recorded in the chat. Leaving this page hangs up.
